paragraphs.text: Here is the whole trick, and it is not a trick you do: any sound that comes out of your mouth is already a sacred word. Any way your body happens to be sitting or standing is already the holy gesture. Any breathing your breath does on its own is already the practice.
So if you are living inside that charged place of awareness, tell me: what in the world would not shine?

paragraphs.text: No methods. Whatever you say is already mantra. Whatever your body does is already mudra. Whatever your breath does is already yoga.
Live inside that charged ground and everything shines. What exactly would stay dark?
